comments.body: This is completely untrue, you can publish by getting involved in a lab and staying there for your master’s thesis for e.g. Just that might get you authorship (not first or second most of the time obviously) on a paper and if you decide to stay longer in that lab before starting the PhD you can make sure that you have at least 1. I had 2 papers out before starting
